name: Moonshot Recurrent-Factored Mainline (FA3)
blurb: Runnable moonshot scaffold that replaces the 11-block trunk with a shared-depth recurrent transformer: 5 unique blocks, 3 recurrent loops, factorized tied embeddings, BigramHash(3072,112), XSA on all unique blocks, Parallel Muon, and the existing mixed int6 export path. Defaults target the runnable sp1024 path first; metrics pending verification.
author: fahmitech
